Professional Experience  
As a Senior Backend Engineer at NebulaTech, I spearheaded the architecture of a real-time analytics platform that processes 12M+ events daily, achieving 99.99% uptime. Prior to this, I led a team of 5 engineers at ScaleVentures, scaling a SaaS product from 200 to 5,000 users in 18 months, with a 40% reduction in latency through optimized PostgreSQL queries. My career began at StellarStartups, where I built a core API for a fintech app, handling 500K+ transactions monthly with Go and Python, which later became a key revenue driver.  

Technical Skills  
Architected and maintained microservices-based systems using Go, Python, and REST APIs, with a focus on scalability and fault tolerance. Designed a MongoDB sharding strategy that reduced query latency by 60% for a user engagement dashboard, while PostgreSQL optimizations at ScaleVentures cut report generation time from 15 to 3 seconds. Integrated Prometheus/Grafana for real-time monitoring, enabling proactive incident resolution and reducing MTTR by 35%. CI/CD pipelines at NebulaTech automated 80% of deployment workflows, ensuring zero-downtime updates for critical services.  

Education  
BSc in Computer Science, University of Lagos (2018). Graduated with distinction, focusing on distributed systems and high-performance databases.  

Projects  
- **Nebula Analytics Engine**: Developed a serverless microservices architecture using Go and Python, handling 12M+ events/day with Kafka and MongoDB. Implemented REST APIs for real-time data ingestion, reducing latency by 45% through asynchronous processing.  
- **ScaleVentures SaaS Platform**: Refactored monolithic architecture into 6 microservices, improving deployment speed by 50% and reducing database bottlenecks via PostgreSQL indexing and query optimization.  
- **StellarStartups Fintech API**: Built a secure, rate-limited API with Python and Redis, supporting 500K+ transactions/month. Later expanded to include GraphQL endpoints, increasing feature adoption by 25%.  

Languages  
English (fluent), Hebrew (professional working knowledge), Spanish (basic).

- Won “Innovator of the Year” at ScaleVentures for introducing a Python-based data pipeline that cut ETL processing time by 70%.  
- Featured in TechCrunch for contributing to NebulaTech’s open-source Prometheus integration toolkit, used by 15+ startups.
